programme.desc: Monty becomes nervous when he breaks Jeanie's project and doesn't know whether to tell her. He soon learns that you should always be honest.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Run a Marathon
programme.desc: JoJo's worried she will be joining Jared on his marathon until she realises she's just going to support him! JoJo learns that being a supporter is almost as important as being a runner.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Accessory Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Caernarfon Castle, Wales
programme.desc: How will the Go Jetters retrieve Xuli's treasured 'Academy Ace' flying trophy from Caernarfon Castle?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Celery
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Plum
programme.desc: Live from the Roots &amp; Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Cereal Mountain
programme.desc: Chilli is determined to make it to the top of Cereal Mountain without the help of Supertato and his gadgets. Evil Pea tries to get there first by cheating.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Dragon Boat Beats
programme.desc: The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Backwards and Forwards
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have fun moving backwards and forwards. The Tubby Custard Ride goes forwards, then backwards, then forwards again!

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Truth: Final Episode
programme.desc: Raymond's lawyer licence is suspended as he has prevented the course of justice to clear his mother's conviction. He is subsequently framed for murder with every piece of evidence pointing towards him. The only one with proof of his innocence is his dying mother, who fights to stay alive long enough to exonerate her son before it is too late.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

Jess thinks he may need help building a little house, or that he's cold or needs a drink. But it's only when his farmyard buddies who are busy playing 'Scarey Steps' come and shout 'Scarey!' that Jess realises little HH curles up when he's frightened.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Make The Most Beautiful Garden Ever?

Raking away the swirls doesn't work, they just come back! Jess and Mimi realise that worms are making the swirly piles of earth. Mimi wants to move them away but they go back underground before she can catch them.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There Little Hills In The Orchard?

That's the Big Question. Jess wonders if someone put them there. He asks Mimi, who's making a pile of earth while she digs a hole. She tells him she's going to plant an apple tree. Maybe someone's been planting new apple trees in the orchard thinks Jess.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are There So Many Ladybirds?
programme.desc: One winter morning Jess finds lots of ladybird in his barn. Why are they there? That's the Big Question! Mimi tells him that she has lots of ladybirds in her garden in the summer. They're always hungry and brilliant for the plants because they eat all the greenfly. Maybe they're looking for greenfly in his barn? Jess doesn't think so. There are no greenfly in the barn. He goes to ask Baa and Billie for help.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Stop Little Bird Eating The Seeds?
programme.desc: Mimi's really upset with Little Bird who keeps eating all her lettuce seeds. Jess wonders how they can stop her. They try putting out extra food for her but Little Bird just eats everything! Jess wonders if covering the seeds with something so that Little Bird can't reach them would work. Mimi says it's a good idea but the sun won't reach the seeds either - which means they won't grow. The only thing that seems to stop t Little Bird is when she sees Jess and is frightened away.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Go Up And Down On The See-Saw?
programme.desc: Baa and Billie have built a fantastic new see-saw in the meadow. Jess can't wait to have a go. But when he tries to make it go up and down with him on one end and Baa and Billie on the other he just gets stuck in the air and can't get the see saw down. ‘How can I go up and down on the see saw?' he asks? -desperate to have all the ‘up and down' fun he see the puppies having when they jump on the see-saw.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What Can I Do With My Nature Collection?
programme.desc: Jess shows Mimi his lovely Nature Collection. She really likes it and wonders what he's going to do with it. Now that's a good question! Jess thinks he'll display it but with the pups racing around it'd soon get damaged. He asks Horace if he could use it to make musical instruments, some things make a great sound but others aren't so good. It's time to go on a picnic with Mimi and his friends.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Make My Peach Soft?
programme.desc: JESS and the pups give Baa a peach to eat, thinking it will make a change from grass. But the peach is too hard. How can I make my peach soft? Asks Jess. That's the Big Question! programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP18
programme.desc: Resilience is a word that encapsulates Manchester United centre back Harry Maguire. Since joining Old Trafford for a then world record fee for a defender, Maguire has been at the heart of the highs and lows in a tumultuous period in the club's illustrious history. Despite setbacks including losing the captaincy, being dropped by England and the worst season in the club's history last term, Maguire has never taken a backwards step.

programme.desc: Three decades on from Manchester United's iconic Class of '92, PL Stories steps beyond the headline names to rediscover the teammates who shared the same dressing room, dreams, and demands of one of football's most revered youth systems. We sit down with the lesser-known graduates who lived that journey first-hand, players whose paths diverged from the global spotlight but whose experiences offer a rare and revealing window into the reality behind the legend.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP7
programme.desc: A graduate of the Manchester United 'Class of '92', Paul Scholes is one of the most decorated players in Premier League history. With 11 top flight titles, 3 F.A. Cups and 2 Champions League winners medals to his name, his has rightly been inducted into the Premier League Hall of Fame. We sit down with the Englishman and those who played alongside him to talk through his incredible career that saw him make 499 league appearances and score 107 goals.

programme.title: PL REWIND - EP5

programme.title: City Breaks - Cologne
programme.desc: Cologne is all things romantic from the chocolate museum to its perfume shop. It is a city in love with life, one that knows how to have a good time.

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Brussels
programme.desc: Whether it is Manekin Pis or a quirky comic strip museum, the sights Elisha sees in Brussels leave her in awe of Belgium’s eccentric capital.

programme.title: Bliss - Santorini Greece
programme.desc: With its sea-drowned caldera, black-sand beaches and crimson sunsets, Santorini is the archetypal Greek island fantasy.

programme.title: Best From The Rest - Scenic Lakes
programme.desc: Here’s a list of some of India’s most stunning lakes from the spellbinding blues of Pangong Tso to the regal charms of Lake Pichola.

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Comino, Malta
programme.desc: Azure waters, white sandy beaches, Mediterranean charm and a riveting history make Malta the perfect destination for an island getaway.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Zanskar, India
programme.desc: From stumbling upon a statue of Guru Rinpoche to attending a local festival at a monastery, Alex explores the influence of Buddhism in Zanskar Valley.

programme.title: City Breaks - Barcelona
programme.desc: From Antoni Gaudi’s whims to hosting the 1992 Olympics, Alex finds out that Barcelona has been shaped by many different things.

programme.title: 72 Hours Unplugged - Munich
programme.desc: Baroque palaces, beer festivals, and Bavarian soul - Munich isn’t just charming, it’s unexpectedly deep.

programme.title: Bliss - Cappadocia, Turkey
programme.desc: Turkey is a perfect place for some adventure and old charm with rugged landscapes, carved castles and varied mezze. Hot air balloon is an attractive sport done by all visitor.

programme.title: Best From The Rest - Mauritius; Experience The Romance
programme.desc: To avoid your love life become captive of mundane, we suggest adding a whimsical element to it. Presenting, five best experiences which you can savor together in Mauritius with your "special" someone.

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Gozo Island, Malta
programme.desc: Tara Sumner visits Gozo Island, where she tries scuba diving for the very first time. She also explores the Roman and Arabic heritage.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Srinagar, India
programme.desc: From a magical shikara ride on Dal Lake to an elaborate Kashmiri Wazwan, Alex experiences "paradise on Earth" in Srinagar.

programme.title: World Spas - Kempinski, Jordan
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries out spa treatments, which are inspired by the Dead Sea and the desert surroundings at Hotel Kempinski Ishtar in Jordan.

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Bruges 1
programme.desc: From a visit to a chocolate shop to a canal ride along picturesque waterways, Elisha’s experiences in Bruges leave her transfixed with its romance.

programme.title: Burn Appetit - Innsbruck, Austria
programme.desc: On the last leg of his action-packed gastronomic escapade across Austria, Chef Jolly arrives at the captivating city of Innsbruck.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka - Colombo
programme.desc: The host visits the iconic sights of Colombo, and goes on to take a river safari and visit a turtle hatchery in Bentota.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Tso Moriri, Ladakh, India
programme.desc: Travelling along the scenic Manali-Leh highway, Alex stops and camps at Korzok village, where she explores the simple ways of life.

programme.title: Backpack - Lisbon, Portgual
programme.desc: From the tower of Belém to the Jeronimos Monastery, the sights of Lisbon narrate stories about Portugal’s maritime voyages of discovery.

programme.title: Food Stories - Chinese
programme.desc: Find out how the flavours of China have come to be such an integral part of the cuisine of Singapore.

programme.title: Backpack - Sintra, Portgual
programme.desc: Driek is mesmerized by the fairytale charms of Sintra with its turreted palaces, castle ruins and lavish mansions.

programme.title: Xplore Belgium - Bruges 2
programme.desc: From sipping beer in a 500-year-old bar to visiting one of Bruges’s oldest breweries, Elisha explores the craze that Belgians have for beer.

programme.title: 10 Days Sri Lanka - Galle
programme.desc: The host loses herself in the colonial hangover of Galle. She also finds out about unique traditions such as mask making and stilt fishing.

programme.title: World Spas - Shangri La, Malaysia
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries some of the signature spa treatments of the Shangri La Resort at Kota Kinabalu in Sabah, Malaysia.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Leh, India
programme.desc: From the divine Thikse monastery to the serene Pangong Lake, Alex Outhwaite soaks in the Zen at Leh.

programme.title: Food Stories - Chinese
programme.desc: Find out how the flavours of China have come to be such an integral part of the cuisine of Singapore.

programme.title: Backpack - Sintra, Portgual
programme.desc: Driek is mesmerized by the fairytale charms of Sintra with its turreted palaces, castle ruins and lavish mansions.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP40
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP9
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP25
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP6
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP7
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP2
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP15
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP7
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: The Defected - EP29
programme.desc: Inspector Sheung-bang of the Crime Squad was once a rising star in the police force. While trying to save a colleague, he was shot by a gangster, his life forever changed. After his miraculous survival, Sheung-bang pursues his case with even greater resolve, earning him the nickname "Iron Detective," though he constantly suffers from the aftereffects.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP1
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP16
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP9
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP1
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP1
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP10
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP1
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP7
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP9
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.desc: 2025年的最後一天，第一財經陪你一起度過。即將過去的2025年，生活彷彿被按下了加速鍵，信息爆炸，似乎所有行業都在發生着鉅變。關稅、股市、黃金價格都成爲每日上下翻飛、隨時要衝破記錄的數字，攪動着國際貿易與大國關係，也攪動着我們每個人的日常生活。大模型、機器人、商業航天，硬科技的迅猛發展帶飛了全球資本的流向，令人應接不暇的同時也讓我們思考如何能跟上這樣的節奏。而當新能源車、外賣等行業的競爭進入白熱化、幾十億的資金一天內就能燒完時候，我們一邊更加謹慎的用訂單投票，一邊開始反思如此“內卷”何時有盡頭。所以現在，讓我們一起把時間往回撥，細數2025年，在世界極速變動的當下，我們如何在宏大的敘事中探知未來的模樣，如何在微小的快樂中感受生活的溫度。\r\n我們選取了十個關鍵詞，邀請多位業內重磅嘉賓，一起聊一聊關於2025年的記憶，一起來讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火。

programme.desc: 12月12日，爲期3天的2025全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽在上海張江正式啓幕！這裏的機器人不光能在廢墟中逆行救援、車間裏微米級裝配，還會疊帶污漬的衣服、插錯落有致的鮮花，把“實驗室黑科技”活成了觸手可及的“人間煙火氣”。這場全球頂尖技能比拼，既是技術實力的擂臺，更是資本嗅覺的風向標 —— 既折射出 “十五五”規劃建議中“推動具身智能成爲新經濟增長點” 的政策東風，更藏着2035年突破萬億元的市場藍海。當機器人走進廚房、工廠、醫院，這條 “技術 + 資本” 雙驅動的賽道，到底有哪些普通人也能關注的投資機會？12月12日14:00《數新風》，帶您直擊張江賽場一線：看機器人 “會幹活” 的硬核實力，拆萬億賽道 “能賺錢” 的佈局密碼，一起解鎖科技與生活碰撞的財富新風向！

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY2下午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜信任爲基 數據爲核——共建現代服務業可信數據流通基礎設施
programme.desc: 致力於打造成爲企業數字化轉型與數據資產建設的核心服務載體。通過充分發揮空間集聚與紐帶功能，積極整合技術、資本、人才等產業要素，構建協同共生的服務業數據產業生態。平臺旨在系統性解決企業在數據應用中的實際難題，助力企業真正實現“有數可用、有數敢用”，持續賦能業務創新與高質量發展。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜“申城·數聚行”投融資論壇
programme.desc: 論壇以“數智創新 產融共贏”爲主題，聚焦數字經濟發展中的企業融資需求，着力構建高效精準的數字化產融對接模式。通過強化政府、企業、金融機構與行業協會的多方聯動，會議致力於打造具有示範意義的數字經濟產融合作平臺，推動創新資源與金融資本的有效對接，爲培育新質生產力、促進經濟高質量發展提供堅實支撐。

programme.title: 直播丨Bio+學院“揚帆出海”系列主題直播課·第八期 揚帆拓海 藥通全球
programme.desc: 爲助力本土企業精準把握國際藥政新動向，打通創新藥械海外註冊全鏈條，構建符合國際標準的臨牀試驗質量管理體系，本期直播課聚焦新形勢下上海創新藥出海的戰略佈局、臨牀試驗管理與註冊實操，集結復宏漢霖、泰格醫藥、輝瑞三大頭部藥企的相關領域專家，深度解碼出海核心難題，爲企業國際化征程提供“精準導航”。\r\n上海市生物醫藥產業教育培訓平臺“Bio+學院”聯合行業龍頭企業和知名專家,傾力打造“揚帆出海”主題系列直播課,將從政策法規、行業規劃、產品准入、市場監管等方面,爲企業深度答疑解惑,促進跨境交流，推動多邊合作。\r\n後續敬請期待!

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數惠無界 共贏未來——邁向公共數據價值化新未來
programme.desc: 論壇匯聚全國各省市數據集團代表，系統性回顧了數據產業聯盟年度工作進展，集中發佈了\"兩清單、一互聯\"重要成果及數據要素價格形成機制。舉行了新成員入盟儀式，並圍繞公共數據授權運營、場景創新等關鍵議題展開深入交流，爲推動全國統一數據市場建設、促進數字經濟高質量發展注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數字技術法治保障路徑的探索——國際實踐與本土創新
programme.desc: 本次論壇匯聚司法界、學術界、產業界代表，圍繞數據權益司法保護與數字規則立法等核心議題展開深入交流。與專家共同探討數字技術發展中的法治保障機制，分享全球數字治理經驗與國內創新實踐，爲推動建立適應數字時代的法治框架、促進數字經濟在法治軌道上健康有序發展貢獻智慧與力量。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數鏈生態 智啓未來——第二屆區塊鏈創新高峯論壇
programme.desc: 論壇聚焦區塊鏈技術與產業深度融合的創新實踐，探討如何結合人工智能、物聯網等前沿技術構建安全高效的數據智能流通體系。邀請技術專家、行業領袖，從多元主體需求出發，深入解析區塊鏈在政務、金融、醫療、供應鏈等關鍵領域的應用場景與價值潛力，共同探索區塊鏈技術賦能城市功能升級與治理現代化的創新路徑，爲智慧城市建設注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數制閔行 生態融合——工業數字化的創新與應用
programme.desc: 論壇深度契合全球數商大會主題，聚焦工業軟件領域中數據、算法與算力三大核心要素的協同創新。論壇結合產業基礎優勢，深入探討數智融合背景下的技術突破路徑、產業生態構建與典型應用場景，推動工業軟件關鍵技術攻關與解決方案落地，爲加速工業數字化進程、提升產業鏈現代化水平提供重要支撐。

programme.desc: 本次論壇以“全棧數智化，賦能新未來”爲主題，聚焦全棧數智技術的前沿發展與行業應用，深入解碼各領域數智化轉型的創新模式與實踐路徑。論壇匯聚權威專家，分享數智技術在多個行業的落地應用與成功經驗，現場發佈公共數據安全流通解決方案及系列創新產品，爲充分釋放數據要素價值、推動產業高質量發展提供系統性支撐與可行方案。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜聯接世界 通鏈全球——中國聯通護航企業出海行動
programme.desc: 論壇由中國聯通主辦，聚焦中國企業出海的有效路徑與多元化市場佈局。匯聚行業專家，圍繞服務支撐、風險防範、生態協同等關鍵議題展開深入研討，旨在爲出海企業構建更加完善的服務與保障體系，助力中國企業穩健開拓國際新版圖。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨阿里巴巴2025年第三季度業績發佈會
programme.desc: 11月25日，阿里巴巴集團發佈2026財年第二季度財報（截至9月30日止季度），財報顯示，報告期內阿里收入2478.0億元，同比增長5%，此前市場預估收入爲2452億元，超出市場預期。財報顯示，若不考慮高鑫零售和銀泰的已處置業務的收入，同口徑收入同比增長將爲 15%。

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨蔚來2025年第三季度業績發佈會

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨數字出海 智啓新程——數字長寧，推動出海高質量發展
programme.desc: 由上海市長寧區數據局主辦的分論壇聚焦數字出海新機遇，集中發佈“數字出海”的典型案例，展示長寧區數字化轉型的先進成果，以“虹橋數谷”爲支撐，充分發揮其產業與區位優勢，全力打造面向未來的數字出海門戶樞紐，展示數字化轉型成果，賦能企業開拓全球市場。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨數服無界 園企蝶變——構建數字公共服務生態體系

programme.title: 解財報丨英偉達業績超預期 黃仁勳回擊“AI泡沫論”
programme.desc: 英偉達發佈最新一期財報，第三財季實現創紀錄的570億美元營收，同比增長62%，大幅高於市場預期的551.9億美元；淨利潤爲319億美元，同比大漲65%；經調整後的每股收益爲1.30美元。這一業績大幅超出預期，再次強化了英偉達在AI領域的話語權。此前，包括軟銀集團孫正義等巨頭清倉英偉達，華爾街質疑AI泡沫，英偉達此次財報能否持續驗證AI的長期價值？A股相關產業鏈能否再迎投資機會？11月20日下午13:30，英偉達2026財年第三季度業績交流會+解讀，敬請關注！

programme.title: 直播丨解鎖秋假背後的\
programme.desc: 剛過去的一週，秋假熱度“爆”了，浙江、四川、廣東等多地的中小學放了秋假。機票預訂量突然飆升，熱門景區、博物館門票預約爆單，淡季旅遊市場呈現不“淡”之勢。秋假之中的學生及家長他們的真實體驗如何，解鎖秋假背後的“花錢經濟學”，聚焦普通人能感知的消費趨勢與經濟信號。

programme.desc: 自2025年年末開始，滬指上演15連陽走勢。在商業航天等板塊持續拉昇下，1月9日滬指盤中順利突破4100點大關。春季躁動行情能持續多久，階段調整風險是否正在積聚，哪些板塊值得佈局？1月9日13：00，《市場零距離》邀您關注：深入解讀當下市場，滬指突破4100點，是狂歡起點還是階段頂點？

programme.title: 直播｜直擊黃仁勳2026CES演講 Vera Rubin平臺重磅發佈
programme.desc: 當地時間1月5日，英偉達CEO黃仁勳在CES發表演講，以“AI基礎設施時代與Physical AI的崛起”爲核心，全面展示了英偉達從數字AI向物理世界AI的戰略升級，發佈了新一代計算平臺Vera Rubin、四大開源AI模型家族及多項行業合作，明確AI已從技術浪潮邁入基礎設施階段。

programme.title: 直播·市場零距離 | 解碼科創綜指 —— 聚焦科創板未來發展建設
programme.desc: 當新質生產力成爲時代關鍵詞，“十五五” 規劃建議爲科技創新錨定方向，科創板正迎來政策、產業、資金深度共振的黃金髮展期！而科創綜指，作爲覆蓋科創板核心資產的全景縮影，既是硬科技賽道的 “晴雨表”，更是投資者洞察行業趨勢的核心窗口。2026年，科創板改革持續深化，硬科技賽道風雲變幻，科創綜指將如何勾勒行業發展脈絡？又將爲市場帶來哪些新機遇？\r\n1月5日14:00，《市場零距離》特別節目重磅來襲！我們特邀四大業界權威大咖，爲您解鎖科創板發展與投資的核心邏輯。

programme.title: 直播｜突發！美國轟炸委內瑞拉
programme.desc: 當地時間2026年1月3日凌晨，美軍對委內瑞拉首都加拉加斯發動空襲，多架直升機低空突襲軍事設施並引發爆炸，總統馬杜羅宣佈全國進入緊急狀態。美國總統特朗普稱已抓獲委總統馬杜羅及其夫人並帶離委內瑞拉。局勢將如何發展，第一財經邀請各方專家進行解讀！

programme.title: 首席策略薈 | 預見 “十五五”：解碼政策新座標 搶佔投資新藍海
programme.desc: 《首席策略薈》2025年年終線下沙龍 12月31日下午將重磅上線網絡直播！這場深度交流盛宴，將通過主題演講+圓桌對話的形式，帶您全方位把握 “十五五” 規劃下的投資新機。\r\n宏觀層面，復旦大學教授韋宗友解讀國際環境與大國關係趨勢，九方智投首席經濟學家肖立晟展望中國經濟走向，拆解雙循環戰略轉型邏輯；策略維度，摩根資產管理、浙商證券、九方金融研究所專家共探 2026 春季行情佈局，解鎖 “十五五” 黃金賽道挖掘路徑；行業聚焦，電力設備與新能源、計算機AI兩大熱門領域首席分析師，深度剖析行業觸底反彈機遇與投資邏輯躍遷方向。\r\n權威嘉賓陣容、多維度乾貨輸出，從政策解碼到賽道篩選，從宏觀趨勢到行業細節，助您精準把握政策導向與市場風口，快來鎖定直播，搶佔投資新藍海！

programme.title: 2025年終直播丨十大關鍵詞，讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火
programme.desc: 2025年的最後一天，第一財經陪你一起度過。即將過去的2025年，生活彷彿被按下了加速鍵，信息爆炸，似乎所有行業都在發生着鉅變。關稅、股市、黃金價格都成爲每日上下翻飛、隨時要衝破記錄的數字，攪動着國際貿易與大國關係，也攪動着我們每個人的日常生活。大模型、機器人、商業航天，硬科技的迅猛發展帶飛了全球資本的流向，令人應接不暇的同時也讓我們思考如何能跟上這樣的節奏。而當新能源車、外賣等行業的競爭進入白熱化、幾十億的資金一天內就能燒完時候，我們一邊更加謹慎的用訂單投票，一邊開始反思如此“內卷”何時有盡頭。所以現在，讓我們一起把時間往回撥，細數2025年，在世界極速變動的當下，我們如何在宏大的敘事中探知未來的模樣，如何在微小的快樂中感受生活的溫度。\r\n我們選取了十個關鍵詞，邀請多位業內重磅嘉賓，一起聊一聊關於2025年的記憶，一起來讀懂經濟裏的人間煙火。

programme.title: 直播丨2026年大展望——宏觀經濟與大類資產策略會
programme.desc: 告別2025年，我們將迎來2026年。\r\n新的一年，美聯儲降息節奏如何？國內貨幣政策是否會進一步寬鬆？宏觀經濟的溫和復甦能否延續？A股和港股是否會再上一個臺階?\r\n寧波銀行與您一起前瞻佈局市場，共啓投資新篇!

programme.title: 價值與投資丨硬科技突圍：技術攻堅、產業建設與資本護航
programme.desc: 講好滬市企業的價值邏輯，直面市場關心的投資話題，聚焦高質量發展，共建價值迴歸的市場生態，由上海證券交易所和第一財經發起的“價值與投資”系列投關節目，2025年全新升級。第10期節目邀請斯瑞新材、海天瑞聲高管，與來自東方富海、申萬宏源證券的機構嘉賓，共同探討資本市場支持科技創新的政策紅利、硬科技產業的突圍路徑與發展機遇。

programme.title: 一線發佈丨國家發展改革委介紹國家創業投資引導基金有關工作
programme.desc: 國家發展改革委定於12月26日（星期五）上午10點30分，召開國家發展改革委專題新聞發佈會，介紹國家創業投資引導基金有關工作。

programme.title: 雲程篤行·萬里可期丨2025年度財經思想者盛典
programme.desc: 2025年一財號大V平臺的意見領袖，在宏觀經濟、投資消費、科技新趨勢等時代熱點有着深刻思考。12月23日18:00，2位“2025年度財經思想者”：智彙集團創始人及首席經濟學家夏春、中歐陸家嘴國際金融研究院副院長劉功潤和2位“2025年度行業前行者”：京華世家家族辦公室董事長聶俊峯、新鼎資本董事長張馳，與思想者揭曉人第一財經總編輯楊宇東，共同進行年度思想演說秀。他們將對宏觀趨勢、居民消費、年輕人投資理財、具身智能等問題進行深度探討，尋找2026年可期的結構性機會。助力中國經濟發展雲程篤行、萬里可期。

programme.title: 一線發佈丨國新辦介紹新時代交通運輸服務經濟社會高質量發展有關情況
programme.desc: 國務院新聞辦公室舉行新聞發佈會，交通運輸部副部長李揚介紹新時代交通運輸服務經濟社會高質量發展有關情況，並答記者問。

programme.title: 直播｜2025年EATNS碳管理體系大會暨碳中和行動聯盟可持續發展研討會
programme.desc: 爲進一步推動碳管理體系建設與合作、搭建行業交流平臺、凝聚碳管理領域共識、推動重點行業低碳轉型實踐落地、探討可持續發展與碳管理協同路徑、打造地方低碳經濟發展地標。2025年EATNS碳管理體系大會暨碳中和行動聯盟可持續發展研討會將於2025年12月22日13:30在合肥舉辦，本次大會由上海環交所、EATNS碳管理體系評定工作委員會、碳中和行動聯盟主辦。邀請政府領導、行業專家及在“雙碳”領域取得相應成果的企業高管等建言獻策。

programme.title: 直播丨第十一屆上海公益微電影節頒獎典禮
programme.desc: 歷經十年的積澱，“上海公益微電影節”將在2025年煥新出發：通過進一步融合傳承與創新，讓“上海公益微電影節”的品牌形象能夠與時俱進，成爲新時代中國慈善事業以及人民城市建設的導引；繼續發揮好慈善評選表彰的引導激勵作用，將慈善、公益、社會創新、藝術文化等領域串聯在一起，共同弘揚慈善文化、傳遞公益正能量，共繪美好人民城市生活的未來圖景。

programme.title: 價值與投資丨重塑產業鏈價值 批零行業再突圍
programme.desc: 講好滬市企業的價值邏輯，直面市場關心的投資話題，聚焦高質量發展，共建價值迴歸的市場生態，由上海證券交易所和第一財經發起的“價值與投資”系列投關節目，2025年全新升級。第九期節目邀請小商品城、重慶百貨高管、長江證券首席分析師，共同探討批發零售行業的產業鏈價值重塑。

programme.title: 直播丨海南自貿港正式封關 如何翻開我國制度型開放新篇章？
programme.desc: 2025年12月18日，海南自由貿易港封關將正式啓動，實施以“‘一線’放開、‘二線’管住、島內自由”爲基本特徵的自由化便利化政策制度。海南自貿港封關後如何運作？企業會享受到什麼紅利?《財經夜行線》邀請商務部國際貿易經濟合作研究院研究員周密一起來解析封關背後的制度創新與市場機遇。

programme.title: 直播丨大資管時代的長線增值與生態協同
programme.desc: 當下，中國資管行業處於轉型升級的關鍵階段，打破剛兌、淨值化轉型成爲行業共識，而低利率環境的持續與全球市場的波動，更讓“長線增值”與“生態協同”成爲行業發展的核心關鍵詞。\r\n基於此，第一財經邀請保險、公募基金、券商三大核心機構，從不同視角解讀行業趨勢、共探發展路徑。敬請關注。

programme.title: 直播丨2025第一財經資本年會
programme.desc: 2025年，是中國“十四五”規劃收官與“十五五”規劃謀劃的歷史交匯點。產業鏈、創新鏈、資本鏈的深度融合，已成爲支撐產業升級、培育新質生產力的關鍵路徑。第一財經資本年會以“新里程、新動能”爲主題，聚焦新五年週期下的創新路徑與產業躍遷，深入探討資本市場如何更高效服務實體經濟、創新要素如何優化配置，以及如何構建開放協同的產業創新生態系統。

programme.title: 直播丨不是“封島”！海南封關對個人、產業及開放格局究竟有何影響？
programme.desc: 2025年12月18日，海南自由貿易港正式啓動全島封關運作。從藍圖繪就到落地生根，歷經多年籌備，成爲中國第一個全面實施封關政策的自由貿易港。這一重大舉措，也標誌着中國對外開放進入全新階段。海南全島封關首日，第一財經派出記者進行實地探訪，並邀請專家學者和觀察員共同進行政策解讀，深入探討海南自貿港封關運作對於普通人生活、海南產業發展以及中國開放格局究竟有何影響。

programme.title: 直播丨《自貿港·財經視界》啓播儀式
programme.desc: 由海南廣播電視總檯與上海廣播電視臺第一財經聯合打造的權威財經欄目《自貿港·財經視界》啓播儀式即將舉行。來自海南省委省政府相關部門、金融機構、研究機構、重點園區、企業和媒體代表等近百位嘉賓，共同見證欄目啓播，並就封關後海南的發展機遇與制度構建展開深度研討。

programme.title: 一線發佈丨2025年11月份國民經濟運行情況新聞發佈會+第一時間解讀
programme.desc: 國務院新聞辦公室將於2025年12月15日（星期一）上午10時舉行新聞發佈會，請國家統計局新聞發言人、總經濟師、國民經濟綜合統計司司長付凌暉介紹2025年11月份國民經濟運行情況，並答記者問。第一財經將全程直播並邀請前海開源基金首席經濟學家楊德龍和智彙集團創始人及首席經濟學家夏春第一時間解讀。敬請關注！

programme.title: 直播丨“匯見新機，策馬新程” 匯正財經2026 資本市場策略會
programme.desc: 2025年全球經濟承壓，國內經濟在政策精準發力下彰顯韌性，新質生產力加速崛起，科創板改革深化，新能源、低空經濟等賽道釋放萬億級發展空間。恰逢“十五五” 開局之際，匯正財經“匯見新機，策馬新程”2026 資本市場策略會將於12月14日舉辦。業內專家齊聚，解析宏觀政策、拆解賽道價值、解讀政策紅利，誠邀您共探“十五五”時期的投資邏輯與財富圖景。

programme.title: 價值與投資丨蛻變破局 文娛行業新敘事
programme.desc: 講好滬市企業的價值邏輯，直面市場關心的投資話題，聚焦高質量發展，共建價值迴歸的市場生態，由上海證券交易所和第一財經發起的“價值與投資”系列投關節目，2025年全新升級。第八期節目邀請東方明珠董祕、上海電影董祕、中金公司研究部執行總經理，共同探討文娛行業的蛻變破局。

programme.title: 數新風 | 當機器人走進 “人間煙火” 萬億機會如何佈局？—— 直擊 2025 全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽
programme.desc: 12月12日，爲期3天的2025全球開發者先鋒大會暨國際具身智能技能大賽在上海張江正式啓幕！這裏的機器人不光能在廢墟中逆行救援、車間裏微米級裝配，還會疊帶污漬的衣服、插錯落有致的鮮花，把“實驗室黑科技”活成了觸手可及的“人間煙火氣”。這場全球頂尖技能比拼，既是技術實力的擂臺，更是資本嗅覺的風向標 —— 既折射出 “十五五”規劃建議中“推動具身智能成爲新經濟增長點” 的政策東風，更藏着2035年突破萬億元的市場藍海。當機器人走進廚房、工廠、醫院，這條 “技術 + 資本” 雙驅動的賽道，到底有哪些普通人也能關注的投資機會？12月12日14:00《數新風》，帶您直擊張江賽場一線：看機器人 “會幹活” 的硬核實力，拆萬億賽道 “能賺錢” 的佈局密碼，一起解鎖科技與生活碰撞的財富新風向！

programme.title: 一線論壇丨2025 AI+產業應用創新大會

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會丨2025全球數商大會大放送-DAY2下午場
programme.desc: 11月25-26日，2025全球數商大會在上海啓幕之際，第一財經APP將重磅推出《2025全球數商大會大放送》專屬直播，深度聯動這場以 “數聯全球 商通未來 —— 乘數無界∞” 爲主題的行業盛會。作爲大會核心傳播窗口，直播緊扣大會 “乘數築基、數鏈全球、數聚生態、數智未來” 四大核心方向，在“十五五” 數智導向下，以 “案例解析 + 趨勢預判” 解碼數據要素市場化邏輯，爲全球觀衆搭建數商生態洞察橋樑。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜信任爲基 數據爲核——共建現代服務業可信數據流通基礎設施
programme.desc: 致力於打造成爲企業數字化轉型與數據資產建設的核心服務載體。通過充分發揮空間集聚與紐帶功能，積極整合技術、資本、人才等產業要素，構建協同共生的服務業數據產業生態。平臺旨在系統性解決企業在數據應用中的實際難題，助力企業真正實現“有數可用、有數敢用”，持續賦能業務創新與高質量發展。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜“申城·數聚行”投融資論壇
programme.desc: 論壇以“數智創新 產融共贏”爲主題，聚焦數字經濟發展中的企業融資需求，着力構建高效精準的數字化產融對接模式。通過強化政府、企業、金融機構與行業協會的多方聯動，會議致力於打造具有示範意義的數字經濟產融合作平臺，推動創新資源與金融資本的有效對接，爲培育新質生產力、促進經濟高質量發展提供堅實支撐。

programme.title: 直播丨Bio+學院“揚帆出海”系列主題直播課·第八期 揚帆拓海 藥通全球
programme.desc: 爲助力本土企業精準把握國際藥政新動向，打通創新藥械海外註冊全鏈條，構建符合國際標準的臨牀試驗質量管理體系，本期直播課聚焦新形勢下上海創新藥出海的戰略佈局、臨牀試驗管理與註冊實操，集結復宏漢霖、泰格醫藥、輝瑞三大頭部藥企的相關領域專家，深度解碼出海核心難題，爲企業國際化征程提供“精準導航”。\r\n上海市生物醫藥產業教育培訓平臺“Bio+學院”聯合行業龍頭企業和知名專家,傾力打造“揚帆出海”主題系列直播課,將從政策法規、行業規劃、產品准入、市場監管等方面,爲企業深度答疑解惑,促進跨境交流，推動多邊合作。\r\n後續敬請期待!

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數惠無界 共贏未來——邁向公共數據價值化新未來
programme.desc: 論壇匯聚全國各省市數據集團代表，系統性回顧了數據產業聯盟年度工作進展，集中發佈了\"兩清單、一互聯\"重要成果及數據要素價格形成機制。舉行了新成員入盟儀式，並圍繞公共數據授權運營、場景創新等關鍵議題展開深入交流，爲推動全國統一數據市場建設、促進數字經濟高質量發展注入新動能。

programme.title: 2025全球數商大會｜數字技術法治保障路徑的探索——國際實踐與本土創新

programme.title: 直擊業績會丨阿里巴巴2025年第三季度業績發佈會

programme.desc: 時間來到2012年，彩香邁入六十六歲，什麼都不缺。財富自由、身體堪用、愛情穩定，不受孩子牽絆，發貴小鷗為伴，可說是「六六大順」。以為晚年就這樣了，但…天外竟飛來一哥的老母親，彩香的人生進入番外篇，扮起她人生沒扮過的角色：媳婦。

programme.title: 阿叔第10集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.desc: 以民眾健康為主旨的座談節目，製作單位特別邀請名主持人廖偉凡、陳力瑜以及臺大醫院等各科主治醫師、竹善堂中醫體系、大樹連鎖藥局等專業醫療團隊，與觀眾分享生活上的健康資訊與各種DIY小撇步。

programme.title: 豆腐媽媽第6集
programme.desc: 一部以傳統手工豆腐為核心的戲劇，將故事將圍繞著「萬家」的豆腐老店，雖然看似平凡，卻因為「一個家庭三個姓氏」以及「豆腐祕方只傳姓萬的男丁」的家訓，埋下了充滿衝突與矛盾的伏筆。

programme.title: 民視晚間新聞
programme.desc: 民視提供即時政治、國際、財經、生活、社會、地方、娛樂最真實的報導、最多元的內容，掌握最新消息、生活動態，都在民視新聞。

programme.title: 豬哥亮經典秀第12集
programme.desc: 《豬哥亮經典秀》不僅帶給觀眾歡樂和笑聲，還有許多社會關懷的元素。豬哥亮通過喜劇的形式，闡述對社會現象和人情世故的觀察和思考。他的幽默風格融入了對生活的態度和智慧，使節目更具意義和價值。《豬哥亮經典秀》在臺灣電視界享有很高的評價和知名度，成為了豬哥亮的代表作之一。這個節目也讓豬哥亮贏得了許多獎項和觀眾的喜愛，並在他逝世後成為了他不朽的精神財富。

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1251集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 阿叔第11集
programme.desc: 王文欽從小住在嘉義朴子，是當地唯一的「木工傢俱修復師」，傳承老一輩的工匠精神，文欽做事認真，初戀沒有開花結果的他，一生未娶，獨力撫養姪子姪女。他不僅修復破損的傢俱，更看見歷史的痕跡和故事。而他深切希望修復自己的老家，找回失落的傢俱，延續家族的回憶。 文欽的初戀情人紀明珠從臺北回到嘉義朴子，揭開了文欽不為人知的過去與隱藏的祕密。其後兩人開始重新找尋新的情感模式，修復了心中那些被時間模糊的回憶和情感。文欽用他的技藝和愛心，修復人們與自己心中的缺憾，並帶來了希望與溫暖

programme.title: 綜藝大集合第1251集
programme.desc: 由胡瓜領軍主持的民視綜藝強檔，其中「壽星大發生日快樂」單元幫不少藝人找到了許久不見的親人、朋友及恩人，感人的故事常讓觀眾看得淚流滿面。 全新企劃「綜藝大集合水上大作戰」！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 提煉時光第2集
programme.desc: 《提煉時光-新北藝術家檔案紀錄片系列》由新北市美術館自2018年起推動的藝術史研究計畫之一，旨在透過口述歷史與影像紀錄，梳理新北市的藝術文化發展脈絡，珍藏藝術家的創作歷程與心路歷程。該系列紀錄片以《提煉時光》為名，傳達藝術家創作歷程的自我淬鍊及專注堅持...

programme.title: 南國有藝思第3集
programme.desc: 生活裡總有巧思，每一片土地上，也總有些人正揮灑自我能力，讓生活或生命與眾不同，有些是基於對土地的熱愛、有些是興趣、有的則是正在逐夢。節目從文化、創意的角度出發，探訪地方人、地方事，看這些在地人物，如何活出生命的精采，也讓屏東這塊土地有了更豐潤的底蘊。

programme.title: 文藝賦格第38集
programme.desc: 融合在地與全球，開拓多元豐富的文化景觀。如同音樂「賦格」一般的創作形式，眾聲雲集，成就臺灣文藝的合唱。

programme.title: 另一種注目第38集
programme.desc: 《另一種注目》是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索臺灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第237集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大樑，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣臺語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句臺灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2024未來與希望系列講座第51集
programme.desc: 佛光山惠中寺2024未來與希望系列講座以「古．今」為主題，邀請臺灣詩人、散文家、現任臺灣師範大學國文研究所兼任教授陳義芝，主講「詩心接千載：古典與現代」。佛光山中區總住持覺居法師開場介紹，陳義芝老師出版著作30本，超過一半是詩集，對現代詩的用心極深。

programme.title: 探索大腦第11集
programme.desc: 邀請學者專家與醫學界各科相關醫師，針對不同的腦部相關議題進行討論與提醒，藉由淺顯易懂的醫療科學，一窺複雜精密的大腦結構，節目中還加入探討腦部相關疾病的片段電影，讓大眾更容易認識腦部衰退帶來的生活影響，並有簡易的養生操教學，預防腦部疾病，歡迎收看本節目，讓我們一起來探索大腦！

programme.title: 梵音清流第6集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 小貓巴克裏第8集
programme.desc: 頓時失去雙親的小男孩魚嘟，害怕面對只有自己一人的家。於是，踏上了屬於自己的旅程，卻意外來到一座城市。整個城市的居民全都是動物，他們穿著日常，也有著自己的職業與身份，就跟一般人類沒有什麼不同。被誤以爲是猴子的魚嘟很快的融入這座城市，還認識了小貓巴克裏與幾個好朋友，漸漸的，魚嘟走出陰霾，更把小貓巴克裏當作這輩子最要好的朋友。

programme.desc: 臺灣第一個以全球瀕危物種為主題的自然紀實節目系列，你將深刻感受這些與我們真實共存的臺灣精靈們，牠們面臨的危機及生存困境。

programme.title: 城市紀錄簿第3集
programme.desc: 《城市紀錄簿》透過攝影機的鏡頭，深入城市的每個角落，捕捉並記錄下城市的生活、文化、歷史和人物。每一集將聚焦一個城市，帶領觀眾走訪那些令人驚嘆的地方，發現城市中獨有的風景和故事。

programme.desc: 生活裡總有巧思，每一片土地上，也總有些人正揮灑自我能力，讓生活或生命與眾不同，有些是基於對土地的熱愛、有些是興趣、有的則是正在逐夢。節目從文化、創意的角度出發，探訪地方人、地方事，看這些在地人物，如何活出生命的精采，也讓屏東這塊土地有了更豐潤的底蘊。

programme.title: 文藝賦格第39集
programme.desc: 融合在地與全球，開拓多元豐富的文化景觀。如同音樂「賦格」一般的創作形式，眾聲雲集，成就臺灣文藝的合唱。

programme.title: 另一種注目第39集
programme.desc: 《另一種注目》是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索臺灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄。

programme.title: 人生調色盤第238集
programme.desc: 歌仔戲小生陳亞蘭小姐首次獨挑大樑，主持深度人物訪談節目【人生調色盤】。 「人生」問題是一門大學問，悲歡離合、生老病死是每個人會經歷的過程，特別是隨著社會發展而衍生出新的問題，例如職場與網路的霸凌、憂鬱症、親人失智長照…等，都是過去所罕見的。 節目透過嘉賓的經驗分享，輔以專家學者從旁論述分析，掌握選擇的思考過程，釐清正確的觀念，藉以產生改變自己的能量。主持人陳亞蘭也發揮歌仔戲隱惡揚善的精神，將「忠孝節義」的處世準則，於節目中傳播出去。 為了推廣臺語之美，特別規劃「亞蘭話俗語」單元，每集介紹一句臺灣俚俗語，簡單直白卻字字珠璣，不僅學習到老祖宗的智慧，也貼近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2024未來與希望系列講座第52集
programme.desc: 佛光山惠中寺2024未來與希望系列講座以「古．今」為主題，邀請臺灣詩人、散文家、現任臺灣師範大學國文研究所兼任教授陳義芝，主講「詩心接千載：古典與現代」。佛光山中區總住持覺居法師開場介紹，陳義芝老師出版著作30本，超過一半是詩集，對現代詩的用心極深。

programme.title: 探索大腦第12集
programme.desc: 邀請學者專家與醫學界各科相關醫師，針對不同的腦部相關議題進行討論與提醒，藉由淺顯易懂的醫療科學，一窺複雜精密的大腦結構，節目中還加入探討腦部相關疾病的片段電影，讓大眾更容易認識腦部衰退帶來的生活影響，並有簡易的養生操教學，預防腦部疾病，歡迎收看本節目，讓我們一起來探索大腦！

programme.title: 梵音清流第6集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 小貓巴克裏第9集
programme.desc: 頓時失去雙親的小男孩魚嘟，害怕面對只有自己一人的家。於是，踏上了屬於自己的旅程，卻意外來到一座城市。整個城市的居民全都是動物，他們穿著日常，也有著自己的職業與身份，就跟一般人類沒有什麼不同。被誤以爲是猴子的魚嘟很快的融入這座城市，還認識了小貓巴克裏與幾個好朋友，漸漸的，魚嘟走出陰霾，更把小貓巴克裏當作這輩子最要好的朋友。

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第22集

programme.title: 【戲說人間】河洛歌子戲
programme.desc: 《戲說人間》乃河洛歌仔戲團歷年嘔心瀝血、精心製作的多部經典公演大戲，如「戲弄傳奇」、「賣身作父」、「新鳳凰蛋」、「啞女告狀」、「風冠夢」等精彩絕倫的表演，是歌仔戲迷不可錯過的戲碼。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視臺定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視臺的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 提煉時光第3集
programme.desc: 《提煉時光-新北藝術家檔案紀錄片系列》由新北市美術館自2018年起推動的藝術史研究計畫之一，旨在透過口述歷史與影像紀錄，梳理新北市的藝術文化發展脈絡，珍藏藝術家的創作歷程與心路歷程。該系列紀錄片以《提煉時光》為名，傳達藝術家創作歷程的自我淬鍊及專注堅持...

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第396集
programme.desc: 臺視60週年臺慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的臺灣女人，在臺灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與臺灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 360行向前衝第682集
programme.desc: 360行故事多，體驗各行各業，發掘賺錢新36計。透過體驗各產業的紀錄與分享，瞭解各行各業的創業維艱，發掘其獨到之處、獨門技術，發現"不可思議"的新商機，以及驚人的經濟效益；或是體驗寓工作於娛樂，當個最樂在工作的幸福人，透過打工體驗瞭解與分享更多臺灣不為人知的感動故事。

programme.title: 閻小妹第29集
programme.desc: 故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。

programme.title: 行動現場第545集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 青春愛讀書第352集
programme.desc: 青春愛讀書 開啟年輕閱讀新風潮 青春愛讀書，看年輕人讀什麼書！

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第240集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第8集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1423集

programme.title: 生活地球村第252集

programme.title: 風月同天第2集

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第176集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人羣，自助助人。

programme.title: 行動現場第546集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 幸福美容院第9集
programme.desc: 在天母開設美容院的瑞玉，因為小時候家裏曾受幫助，她只要有機會就會回饋社會想辦法幫助別人。她發現啟智學校的學生只要好好的教導，是可以自立的，所以他毅然決然的接下訓練啟智生成為美容師的這個不可能的任務….

programme.title: 映照人生第485集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 草根菩提第3985集
programme.desc: 有一羣人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人「用鼓掌雙手做環保」的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念、數字或儀器。這是一羣很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第167集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文講堂第586集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 美好心境界第1集
programme.desc: 單親媽媽美淑獨自帶著三個小孩，落腳基隆，在證券公司工作，在股票飛漲的日子裡，公司裡多餘的便當成為美淑和三個小孩渡日果腹的主食。便當歲月日子雖苦，但是，一家人可以依偎在一起，是美淑支撐下去最大的力量。 好姊妹誠懿的丈夫宏業罹患白血病，還沒等到配對成功就撒手人寰，卻開啟美淑進入慈濟的大門。一趟花蓮尋根列車之旅以後，美淑正式加入培訓的隊伍。 後來，美淑考上營業員，適逢股市上萬點，沉迷在名牌跟美食的慾海中，直到參加水懺共修手語表演，開始她齋戒茹素的生活。 最後，美淑放下二十幾年來對前夫的怨懟，把他渡到慈濟裡來一起奉獻，成就他人，也圓滿自己。

臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裏，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平臺，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 人文講堂第586集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 美好心境界第1集
programme.desc: 單親媽媽美淑獨自帶著三個小孩，落腳基隆，在證券公司工作，在股票飛漲的日子裡，公司裡多餘的便當成為美淑和三個小孩渡日果腹的主食。便當歲月日子雖苦，但是，一家人可以依偎在一起，是美淑支撐下去最大的力量。 好姊妹誠懿的丈夫宏業罹患白血病，還沒等到配對成功就撒手人寰，卻開啟美淑進入慈濟的大門。一趟花蓮尋根列車之旅以後，美淑正式加入培訓的隊伍。 後來，美淑考上營業員，適逢股市上萬點，沉迷在名牌跟美食的慾海中，直到參加水懺共修手語表演，開始她齋戒茹素的生活。 最後，美淑放下二十幾年來對前夫的怨懟，把他渡到慈濟裡來一起奉獻，成就他人，也圓滿自己。

programme.title: 美好心境界第2集
programme.desc: 單親媽媽美淑獨自帶著三個小孩，落腳基隆，在證券公司工作，在股票飛漲的日子裡，公司裡多餘的便當成為美淑和三個小孩渡日果腹的主食。便當歲月日子雖苦，但是，一家人可以依偎在一起，是美淑支撐下去最大的力量。 好姊妹誠懿的丈夫宏業罹患白血病，還沒等到配對成功就撒手人寰，卻開啟美淑進入慈濟的大門。一趟花蓮尋根列車之旅以後，美淑正式加入培訓的隊伍。 後來，美淑考上營業員，適逢股市上萬點，沉迷在名牌跟美食的慾海中，直到參加水懺共修手語表演，開始她齋戒茹素的生活。 最後，美淑放下二十幾年來對前夫的怨懟，把他渡到慈濟裡來一起奉獻，成就他人，也圓滿自己。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第167集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人書房第89集
programme.desc: 閱讀就像是漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中！每位名人的讀書故事，皆是一段動人的奇幻旅程，透過《名人書房》紀錄影片帶領大眾看見閱讀改變生命的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第241集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第26集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1424集
programme.desc: 以 證嚴上人出門行腳各地的隨緣開示為內容，近距離同霑一代宗師的法髓甘露與清淨智慧。以真實記錄譜寫現代阿含經，使全球大眾如同親隨。

programme.title: 映照人生第485集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1066集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第876集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 風月同天第16集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合臺灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: MIT臺灣誌第619集
programme.desc: 《MIT臺灣誌》是為臺灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為臺灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT臺灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT臺灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT臺灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了臺灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自臺灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 新霹靂英雄榜第128集
programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神祕的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神祕力量。故事圍繞著一羣英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心絃，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神祕的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 我們的島第1340集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年臺灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是臺灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年臺灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是臺灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 下課花路米第1364集

programme.title: 反正你也不睡覺第16集

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第11集

programme.title: 臺灣人沒在怕第3集

programme.title: 成仁高中偵探社2第11集

programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視臺的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 一字千金第15集
programme.desc: 《一字千金》是臺灣公共電視文化事業基金會監制、全能製作公司製作、天衍互動技術協助、以漢字為主題並體驗中華文字之美的益智競賽節目，號稱“電視史上結合App、最緊張、最刺激的文字書寫比賽”，並曾榮獲第50屆金鐘獎綜合節目獎。由曾國城擔任主持人。節目中所有書寫字體均以傳統漢字版本為主，其標準為中華民國教育部所頒布的標準楷書，並以常用國字標準字體表、次常用國字標準字體表收錄的常用漢字為範疇。至於答案的認定，則以教育部重編國語辭典修訂本為最終依據。

programme.title: 出去一下第26集

programme.title: 出走的好理由第1集
programme.desc: 老於與阿坤伯已邁入70歲，他們是老同事、 老朋友，年輕時還愛過同一個女人（李湘）。老於生性嚴謹、挑剔。阿坤伯為人豁達、爽朗。退休後，老於整天想著「含飴弄孫，安養天年」，偏偏事與願違，孩子們根本當他是空氣。阿坤伯愛自由，愛嘗鮮，偏偏糖尿病惡化，媳婦開始對他嚴格把關，把他軟禁在家裡。阿坤伯不想在家裡等死，因此，他遊說被家人冷落的老於：兩人一起離家出走！這趟旅程，阿坤伯有如脫韁野馬，老於卻顯得鬱鬱寡歡，完全沒有玩樂的慾望。在阿坤伯的積極鼓譟下，兩人結伴去找李湘，卻意外的碰上一堆光怪陸離的事，他們到底會不會見到李湘呢？旅程的終點兩人又該何去何從？

programme.title: 福氣人生第256集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以臺語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽臺語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 禱告大軍迎接復興第1348集
programme.desc: 近年來，全球牧者普遍領受到一個重要的異象：禱告是復興的唯一關鍵。在2005年的禱告年，GOOD TV特別邀請了多位具有禱告恩賜和全面知識的牧者，製作了五個領域的全面禱告專題節目，引導弟兄姊妹更廣泛地守望我們的世界。這些專題將幫助人們更深入地瞭解禱告的重要性，教導他們在各個領域中以禱告為基礎，尋求神的帶領和引導。通過這樣的節目，人們將被鼓勵和激發，積極參與禱告，並為復興和神的國度的來臨而努力。

programme.title: 穿越古今第22集

programme.title: senay345第2季:第211集
programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，「族語童謠裡述說的是我們的根」，全新型態的兒童少年節目《senay345》，將透過活潑創新的兒童音樂節目形式，提供不同族羣孩童一個享受展演的舞臺。每一集會邀請二位孩童，在節目中演唱族語歌曲，聽著小朋友說著族語故事，透過童趣的自然對話與互動激發創作力和表達能力，一起感受到純粹快樂自然的沉浸在族語世界裡。

programme.title: Talagay 我最強！第1季:第7集

programme.title: kakudan時光機第9季:第96集
programme.desc: Kakudan為臺灣原住民排灣語，「文化，慣習」的意思，希望可以從臺灣原住民族雋永的文化，找到實踐的道路。臺灣原住民族在這塊土地上已生活了八千年，祖先留下了珍貴的文化資產與族羣智慧。惟因過去的歷史面對不同時代的遷徙漢化與日治時期殖民政權的幹擾，使得原住民傳統文化的存續面臨斷層與式微的挑戰。然而處於文化逐漸式微的困境，又面對長者生命的迅速凋零，我們如何搶救文化？如何教育下一代有正確的文化知識與視野？如何把傳統說得更清楚？
